_doc: Inputs of the compute accounting used by eval/paper_assets.py (tab_cost.tex, \bres{cost}{...}). Hours come from the model README / training logs; stage-2 pretraining and the interrupted first attempt are derived from the measured stage-1 throughput (hours_from_throughput_of). 'deployed' runs form the chain that produced the deployed model (interrupted warm start -> P1 -> P2 -> distillation, verified on the weights: the distilled model is closer to the stage-2 base than to SFT V1); 'other' runs were spent but are not in that chain. invoiced_total_usd_below: upper bound of the author's invoices covering every run listed here (rentals and teacher API).

stages.label: Tokenizer training + data pipeline
stages.source: README: streaming tokenisation ~3 h, exact dedup ~10 min, download/filtering

stages.label: Interrupted first attempt (warm start of stage 1)
stages.source: README 'Note storiche': stopped at ~4,000 steps; its weights (not the optimizer state) initialised stage 1, so it is part of the chain that produced the deployed weights

stages.label: Pretraining stage 2 (Wikipedia + mC4)
stages.source: 8,000 steps at the stage-1 throughput (the README's ~5 h would require ~100% MFU)

stages.label: Distillation fine-tuning (from stage 2)
stages.source: README: ~3.5 h, 6,016 steps; scripts/07_finetune_distill.sh starts from pretrain_p2/last.ckpt

stages.label: Teacher API (Qwen3-235B-A22B)
stages.source: sum of the per-request 'cost' field of distill/generated/answers.jsonl (79,542 teacher answers)

stages.label: Retrieval index embedding
stages.source: README: e5-small embedding of the passages ~45 min on H100

stages.label: SFT run from a stale checkpoint (discarded)
stages.source: README 'Note storiche'; duration not logged, assumed equal to SFT V1

stages.label: Instruction tuning V1
stages.source: README: ~45 min on H100; from pretrain_p2

stages.label: Rebalanced tuning V3 (from V1, stopped at step 6,000)
stages.source: README: 7,300 steps ~3 h; stopped at step 6,000

rag.source: faiss index.ntotal and metadata.db of the production volume; modal_app.py

inference.source: Modal pricing and deployment measurements in the model README
